overview: کارزار بتی سعی دارد به همه جذب شود. نامزدهای واقعی به‌طرز طنزآمیزی تقلید می‌شوند، اما وعده‌های انتخاباتی کمی عجیب‌اند.
overview_en: Betty runs for the office of President against Mr. Nobody. Both candidates state their platform through song and dance, referring to political issues of the time. Not long after this cartoon was released, Herbert Hoover was defeated by Franklin D. Roosevelt in the 1932 presidential election.
